historical_references.reference: Muayyad al-Din al-Shirazi was a Persian astronomer and mathematician. He wrote an astronomical work known as the 'Zij-e Jadid' or 'New Astronomy', which is considered the most important Islamic work in this field after the works of Al-Biruni and Al-Khwarizmi. The work was completed around 1079 CE in Shiraz, Persia.

historical_references.reference: Muayyad al-Din al-Shamsi was a renowned Islamic scholar, theologian, and jurist from Damascus, Syria, who is best known for his work 'Al-I'tisam' (The Protection), a classic work on Islamic law and ethics.
